images.title: Images
images.description: Optional reference image(s), each an http(s) URL or base64, one to 10 total. The first is the image being edited and sets the default output size.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, as in flux-3-image. `auto` (default): for edits, the first reference's exact aspect; for text-to-image, a ratio picked from the prompt (prompt rewrite, else ratio keywords, else 16:9) at the requested tier. Ignored when width and height are set.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Equal-area size tier, as in flux-3-image: `768sq`, `1k`, `1.5k`, `2k` or `4k`. Omitted: `1k` for text-to-image; for edits the first reference's own size, or its nearest tier when aspect_ratio is set. Ignored when width and height are set.

width.title: Width
width.description: Exact output width in pixels, [64, 6256]; set together with height. Overrides resolution and aspect_ratio.

height.title: Height
height.description: Exact output height in pixels, [64, 6256]; width x height at most 16822272 pixels (16.8 MP, the largest 4k bin).

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for reproducibility; random when omitted.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: Harm moderation tolerance from 0 to 7, with 0 the strictest. The route and organization determine the approved maximum and per-category ceilings. Unapproved levels return 422 with approved levels.

title: Flux3ImageKleinInputs
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein: text-to-image, or editing with up to 10 reference images.
